behaviors.name: DiceBox M3 — Servant Bell Pull Installation

behaviorSpec.missingMessage: The empty fitting beside the servant bell board is missing its pull.
behaviorSpec.successMessage: The Servant Bell Pull fits the weathered bracket. The restored line takes tension, and the bell board mechanism can now respond.

behaviorSpec.message: The resolved bell-board mechanism has exposed a hidden recess containing the Bell Crest.

specification.failureHint: The service wall feels incomplete in a way that is difficult to place.
specification.successHint: The servant bell board has an obvious missing pull or fitting beside its mechanism.

interpretation.investigation: The missing fitting is meant to engage the bell mechanism rather than serve as decoration.

behaviorSpec.successMessage: The servant bell board is incomplete. One line ends at an empty fitting where a pull should attach, and the surrounding mechanism appears designed to respond when that line is restored.
behaviorSpec.criticalClueFallback: Deliberate inspection of the bell board reveals the missing pull-and-fixture relationship.

specification.successHint: A few service objects have been moved much more recently than the surrounding dust suggests.

behaviorSpec.successMessage: The kitchen's neglect is uneven. Dust has been disturbed around a service surface, and a few practical objects were moved recently enough to stand out from the surrounding decay. Someone has used this wing more recently than the rest of the Lodge suggests.
behaviorSpec.criticalClueFallback: Deliberate inspection of the recently disturbed service area remains possible.
